The most dominant structural element is a large, arched overhead structure, likely a bridge, which frames the upper portion of the image. The dark, ribbed undersides of the bridge create a strong, shadowed canopy contrasting sharply with the bright light. Below the bridge is a wide expanse of water reflecting the bright sunlight, which is intensely shining on the water's surface in the middle distance, creating a strong glare and halo effect. The scene is anchored in the right foreground by a young woman who is the closest to the viewer, seen from behind. Another individual (and possibly others) are visible on the paved walkway to the left, one of whom is clearly visible.
